setTimerDesc: Displays the elapsed time on measurement task pages.
setRevealDesc: Shows all expected values right away and hides reveal buttons.
setAutoDesc: Outputs a reference signal for oscilloscope AUTO setup before each task.
setConfirmDesc: Asks for confirmation before leaving an active measurement series.
wifiDesc: Automatically connects HeadlessScopeBuddy to an existing 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network at startup (automatic channel selection). Falls back to the „HeadlessScopeBuddy“ access point if unreachable.
wifiSavedSta: Saved! ESP32 is rebooting and connecting to “{ssid}”…
wifiSavedAp: Reset! ESP32 is rebooting into Access Point mode…
test1Desc:
CH1 / GPIO25
1 kHz, 50% duty cycle
Level: approx. 0 to 3.3 V
Connect probe ground to board GND.
When stopped, GPIO25 stays LOW.
test2Desc:
CH1 / GPIO25: 1 kHz, 50% duty cycle
CH2 / GPIO26: 1 kHz, 50% duty cycle
Offset CH1 to CH2: 100 µs
Connect both probe grounds to the same board GND.
reset1Ch: Press the AUTO button on your oscilloscope now to prepare the view for measurement.
reset2Ch: Enable CH1 and CH2 with equal scaling, trigger on CH1, then press AUTO on your oscilloscope.
confirmBody: Do you really want to abort the current measurement series and return to the start screen?

examples.PERIODISCHES SIGNAL: Checking a crystal clock generator on a microcontroller board or the switching frequency of a DC/DC converter.
examples.PULSBREITEN: Diagnostics on a PWM-controlled PC fan, a dimmed LED, or an automotive solenoid valve to verify the actual on-time.
examples.BURST: Troubleshooting an infrared remote control or a 433 MHz RF transmitter sending data packets separated by idle pauses.
examples.PULSLÜCKE: Automotive engine diagnostics on a crankshaft position sensor (e.g., 60-2 trigger wheel) where a missing tooth marks top dead center.
examples.SERVOSIGNAL: RC models and robotics – verifying whether the controller outputs 1.0 ms to 2.0 ms pulse width every 20 ms for 0° to 180°.
examples.TACHOSIGNAL: Checking a Hall-effect sensor on an electric motor, pump, or ABS wheel-speed sensor to determine true RPM.
examples.TASTERPRELLEN: Hardware and firmware development – measuring mechanical contact bounce of pushbuttons or relays to size debouncing.
examples.UART 8N1: Commissioning a serial interface (GPS, RS-232/RS-485) to verify the actual baud rate via bit width when seeing garbled characters.
examples.ZUSTANDSWECHSEL: Analyzing FSK modulation (pagers/telemetry) or a drive with two speed stages (creep speed and rapid traverse).
examples.TRIGGER-ANTWORT: Measuring microcontroller interrupt latency or the propagation delay of an optocoupler and gate driver.
examples.PHASENVERSCHIEBUNG: Characterizing RC/LC filters, audio stages, or multiphase converters by comparing input and output phase.
examples.FREQUENZTEILER: Testing counter and flip-flop ICs (e.g., 74HC4040 / CD4017) or prescalers for clean division without missed counts.
examples.ULTRASCHALL-ECHO: Troubleshooting ultrasonic distance sensors (e.g., HC-SR04 in robotics or parking sensors) via echo pulse width (58 µs/cm).
examples.FREIGEGEBENE PWM: Diagnostics on motor drivers or SMPS with an enable pin to measure startup delay after gating.
examples.QUADRATURGEBER: Servicing CNC machines, 3D printers, or rotary encoders – checking 90° phase shift and leading channel.

cPatterns: ^Miss das periodische Digitalsignal an GPIO25 gegen GND\.$
Measure the periodic digital signal on GPIO25 relative to GND.
^Bestimme das Impulspaket und die Low-Pause bis zum nächsten Burst\.$
Determine the pulse packet and the low pause until the next burst.
^In jeder Folge fehlt genau ein Puls\. Suche die vergrößerte Flankenlücke\.$
Exactly one pulse is missing in each train. Find the widened edge gap.
^Ein Modellbauservo bildet 1,0–2,0 ms linear auf 0–180° ab\.$
A hobby servo maps 1.0–2.0 ms linearly to 0–180°.
^Der Tachosensor liefert (\d+) Impulse? pro Umdrehung\.$
The tachometer sensor outputs $1 pulse(s) per revolution.
^Miss den simulierten Schließvorgang vom ersten bis zum letzten Prellsprung\.$
Measure the simulated switch closure from the first to the last bounce edge.
^UART 8N1, Idle HIGH, LSB zuerst\. Dekodiere das wiederholte Byte\.$
UART 8N1, idle HIGH, LSB first. Decode the repeated byte.
^Das Signal wechselt regelmäßig zwischen Zustand A und Zustand B\.$
The signal alternates regularly between State A and State B.
^CH1 löst ein Ereignis aus; CH2 antwortet nach einer definierten Reaktionszeit\.$
CH1 triggers an event; CH2 responds after a defined reaction time.
^CH2 ist gegenüber der steigenden Referenzflanke auf CH1 verzögert\.$
CH2 is delayed relative to the rising reference edge on CH1.
^CH1 zeigt den Eingangstakt, CH2 den ganzzahlig geteilten Ausgangstakt\.$
CH1 shows the input clock, CH2 shows the integer-divided output clock.
^Simulierter Ultraschallsensor: Die Echo-HIGH-Zeit entspricht 58 µs je Zentimeter\.$
Simulated ultrasonic sensor: Echo HIGH duration equals 58 µs per centimeter.
^CH1 ist das Freigabefenster; nur innerhalb dieses Fensters erscheint die PWM auf CH2\.$
CH1 is the gate window; PWM appears on CH2 only inside this window.
^Spur A liegt auf CH1, Spur B auf CH2\. Die führende Spur bestimmt die Richtung\.$
Channel A is on CH1, Channel B is on CH2. The leading channel determines direction.
